morbi.headline: Morbi ceramic sector faces severe export demand contraction and ongoing credit-buyer defaults.
what_changed: Indian ceramic tile export volumes dropped sharply by 46% during Apr-Jul 2026.
Full-year FY27 export outlook for the ceramic tile segment remains projected to be weak.
Instances of inter-state trade credit fraud and buyer default are emerging.
stress_signals: Tile export volumes fell 46% year-on-year for the Apr-Jul 2026 period [434975bd08e0].
A Morbi manufacturer reported a Rs 44.74 lakh loss due to a Mumbai buyer defaulting on a 7,865-box credit order [29ed75c6450d].
what_to_watch: Full-year FY27 export performance metrics and country-wise demand trends.
Unsecured trade credit exposure and buyer payment turnaround times for Morbi tile manufacturers.
Signs of inventory accumulation or working capital stress among export-oriented units.

surat.headline: Surat cluster faces embroidery labor disputes, raw material cost spikes, and diamond export headwinds.
what_changed: Embroidery sector experienced a prolonged three-month labour dispute with worker detentions and planned agitations over wages and holidays.
Textile units faced input-cost shocks with a 50% raw material cost spike and a Rs 50/kg yarn price hike, triggering early Diwali loom shutdowns affecting 75,000 workers.
Surat diamond sector registered a 7% drop in polished diamond shipments and a UK regulatory crackdown on misleading lab-grown diamond ads.
stress_signals: Surat embroidery sector facing a three-month labour dispute and ongoing impasse affecting job-work cash inflows [8a31a5a2c20c, e7921383cbb7].
Over 80 embroidery workers detained during wage and holiday protests [7697e96a190e].
Raw material cost spike and yarn price hike prompting early loom closures and month-long shutdowns affecting 75,000 workers [48c63a4e50b6, b567711c9ed4].

Liquidity and payment defaults reported, including a Rs 70,000 polishing wage default, a Rs 29.57 lakh grey fabric default, and a Rs 10.14 crore textile fraud case [698c779932f2, c4997bb35d98, 2514ad7d6e20].
improvement_signals: GST Council granted Input Tax Credit (ITC) refunds and reduced highway inspections for Surat textiles [17f0a015a73c].
ICA-GemLab is setting up its first Indian laboratory in Surat for diamond and gemstone testing [26bd1ecd549c], and the cluster is expanding into defence technical textiles [0f163b499572].
what_to_watch: Resolution of labor disputes and wage negotiations in the computerized embroidery job-work sector.
Account-level debt servicing and cash flow health for looms affected by early Diwali closures and raw material price spikes.
Impact of the 7% polished diamond export decline and UK advertising regulations on local diamond polishing units.
